title: Roadmap & limits brought up to date
items: Basketball ratings already use pace and points per possession, so that limit and its roadmap item are gone.
Update timing corrected: scores and odds refresh hourly; ratings, Top 25s and picks are rebuilt weekly on Sunday.
Box scores and play-by-play: the model uses them, the site can't show them under the sources' terms.
New limit and roadmap item: injury and availability reports, which the model doesn't have yet.
